verified: edh-d-57 review (Commander lane instead, third pass, EDHREC top 20,000), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings (CR cites from the rules text where checked, else from memory): CR 614.1a, 614.6, 104.3: a one-use shield on the event of you losing the game this turn; instead you draw seven cards and your life total becomes 1 (both instructions are done in place of the loss); then the spell exiles itself (rep.edhd57.nextLoseGame.insteadEffects).

edh-d-57 review: CR 614.1a, 614.6, 616.1, 707.2: the first time you would create tokens during each of your turns (your turn and no token creation by you earlier this turn), you may instead choose a creature on the battlefield other than Esix and create that many tokens that are copies of it (rep.edhd57.firstTokensYourTurn.chooseCopies).

edh-d-57 review: CR 614.1a, 611.2a, 120.3: the activated ability's effect is a replacement of the damage any source you control would deal this turn, doubled (eff.edhd57.damage.double.anySources.toPermanentOrPlayer.dur); the trigger counts quest counters when a source you control deals damage to an opponent.

edh-d-57 review: CR 614.15, 608.2c: exile target creature if its mana value is 3 or less; when its controller has three or more poison counters the second sentence replaces it with exiling that creature unconditionally (the self-replacement fold in render/self-replacement.ts, rid.e2.instead.if).

edh-d-57 review: CR 614.1a, 120.3, 611.3a: while a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn, noncombat damage from a source you control to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls is increased by 2 (sta.edhd57.asLongAs.damageWould.more); the energy trigger is the older reading.

edh-d-57 review: CR 614.1a, 121.1, 611.3a, 701.23a: with six or more quest counters you may replace each draw with a tutor to hand then shuffle (rep.edhd57.asLongAs.youDraw.mayInsteadTutor); the end step trigger counts the cards drawn this turn.

edh-d-57 review: CR 614.1a, 120.3, 701.17a, 400.3: a Zombie you control that would deal combat damage to a player makes that player mill that many cards instead (rep.edhd57.combatDamageToPlayer.insteadMill); a creature card milled into an opponent's graveyard is exiled and a 2/2 Zombie is created (trigger from library to the opponent's graveyard).

edh-d-57 review: CR 614.9, 609.7a, 615.7: you choose a source on the battlefield or stack as the ability resolves; the next damage that source would deal to the target creature this turn is dealt to you instead (eff.edhd57.redirect.nextSourceOfChoice.obj.toYou).
